mapgenerator_caption_panel.task: Judge whether the caption is supported by the visible map image.

caption_support_definitions.supported: All central caption claims are visible or directly inferable from the map.
caption_support_definitions.partly_supported: Some central claims are supported, but at least one important claim is missing, ambiguous, or too strong.
caption_support_definitions.unsupported: The caption contradicts the image or most central claims are not visible.
caption_support_definitions.unclear: The image/caption cannot be judged confidently.

choropleth_cartographic_panel.task: Judge whether the rendered artifact is a usable choropleth-style cartographic artifact.

verdict_definitions.usable: Map content, thematic encoding, title/context, legend/colorbar, and layout are all acceptable.
verdict_definitions.usable_with_minor_issues: Core map content is usable, with minor missing or imperfect cartographic elements.
verdict_definitions.weak: The artifact is visible but has substantial cartographic omissions or layout problems.
verdict_definitions.failed: The artifact is blank, not a map, not inspectable, or lacks core choropleth content.
verdict_definitions.unclear: The artifact cannot be judged confidently.

adjudication.primary_rule: Use two independent human annotations where possible; adjudicate disagreements with a designated expert or third annotator.
adjudication.reporting_rule: Report human agreement separately from VLM agreement and do not relabel VLM outputs as ground truth.
